scopeLimits: The sample is a bounded probe, not a citywide parcel inventory.
The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted; the zero WGS84 probe is only a request outcome.
The service warns that its data are not an official certificate map; no ownership, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
The three returned records included historical/current versions sharing a cadastral label; only the current version was retained.
uncertainty: The WFS response proves public parcel access for Gipuzkoa and a bounded Donostia-area sample, but does not prove complete citywide coverage or adapter readiness. A serial reviewer must independently qualify any runtime integration.
